tail: Inclusive upper empirical tail (N-count_less+1)/(N+1), local/global mixture weight Nlocal/(Nlocal+500). Unseen context falls back to global normal rows. Cold senders exclude the three personal-history components.
aggregation: Maximum of eight negative-log tail values, not a fraud probability or a calibrated p-value.
fit_policy: Every earlier normal-labelled row, without sampling or clipping. Existing fine XGB uses every earlier positive and negative row. History inputs retain all earlier events regardless of label. No 2024 selection or refit.
selection: XGB>=a OR novelty>=b. For each frozen b=-log(tail_level) and disabled novelty, examine every distinct supervised score and disabled supervision. Inclusive ties; maximize TP then fewer FP. Four targets apply to the union. No eligible policy means selected_policy=null. This is only the declared finite novelty grid.
evaluation_limit: Repeated past development selection; not independent validation or evidence of real-world fraud detection.
